structural_model.boundary: dimensionless signals with consistent scaling; arrows express equations, not necessarily physical transport

reduction_with_disturbance.boundary: preserve each retained input/output relation; equal DC gain does not prove equivalent disturbance dynamics

algebraic_movement.takeoffBeforeMovedAfter: if z=2a and branch must remain a, branch=z/2
algebraic_movement.boundary: for dynamic G, formal 1/G may be improper or unstable; algebraic equivalence does not guarantee an implementable compensator

block.boundary: Y=GU alone describes the zero-state contribution; nonzero initial conditions add a free response

drawing_loaded_rc.boundary: derive interconnection equations before assigning isolated component blocks; do not erase loading

feedback.boundary: negative sign is not a universal stability proof; compute closed poles and internal dynamics

algebraic_loop.boundary: a static loop with 1-GH=0 is not a well-defined input-output model; do not divide by zero or call it an ordinary infinite gain
